name: Verity
summary: Near-black AI agent platform site in one soft grotesk, with a centred headline over a cyan light-band shader, two-tone headings, tabbed use cases beside a live dashboard mock and quiet 16px bordered cards.

fonts.pairing: single family: Onest 400 with -0.04em tracking and 1.05 leading for headlines, second line of each heading in grey; Onest 400 to 500 for body and buttons; 12px uppercase 0.06em tag for eyebrows

signature: vertical cyan light-band shader rising from the bottom right of the hero, fading into black
two-tone headings: first line white, second line grey, every section
tabbed use-case list on the left with a full product table mock on the right inside one bordered panel
bento of six benefit cards plus one tall shader card carrying the section CTA
side-by-side comparison with dim cross list versus bright check list
imagery: no photography: crisp dark product UI mocks (task tables, status pills, builders) and a WebGL light-band shader; small line icons in 40px rounded tiles
layout_grid: 1200 frame, 40px sides, 96px section padding, 64px header-to-content gap, left-aligned section headers, 16px card radius with 1px white-6% borders, no shadows, subtle noise overlay on the whole page
